question: Does the paired tiny-versus-base architecture comparison on matched split A seeds reproduce on identity split B?
design_status: Supplemental replication added while the predeclared 20-run campaign was in progress; interpret as exploratory and report transparently.
objective: supervised contrastive loss with a 64-dimensional feature head
matched_comparison: base model with the same split, train seed, augmentation seed, batch, optimizer and stopping rule
cap_extension_rule: If epoch 30 is reached before five epochs have elapsed since the best validation-AUC checkpoint, resume that same run to total epoch 40 and preserve the full history.
cap_extension_rule_addendum_2026_10_22: If a run resumed to epoch 40 still reaches the cap before five no-improvement epochs, continue that same run to a total target of epoch 50 so patience can stop it; this is a post-hoc continuation, not a new seed.
selection_and_test_policy: Select checkpoints and thresholds using only identity-disjoint validation pairs. Do not load the supplied SurvFace final pair annotations or Olivetti.

evaluation.format: float TFLite and full signed-integer INT8 TFLite

interpretation_caveats: This supplemental cell was added after the core campaign had started and is exploratory.
The core 20-run design remains the predeclared confirmatory analysis.
Validation checkpoint-selection optimism applies to all validation metrics.
Pair bootstrap intervals may understate uncertainty because identities and images recur across pairs.
